description: Test whether a neighbouring carboxylate could substitute for the missing Glu348-equivalent in ASNSD1: census of acidic side-chain oxygens around the target residue in the ASNSD1 AlphaFold model, the human ASNS AlphaFold model and the AS-B crystal structure, plus a Fisher test and figure for the deep-taxon motif scan.
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from collections import Counter

AA3 = {'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
       'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}

def parse_pdb(text, chain=None):
    prot, lig = [], []
    for ln in text.split("\n"):
        if not ln.startswith(("ATOM", "HETATM")): continue
        if ln[16] not in (" ", "A"): continue
        rn, ch, at = ln[17:20].strip(), ln[21], ln[12:16].strip()
        if chain and ch != chain: continue
        if at.startswith("H"): continue
        try: rs = int(ln[22:26])
        except ValueError: continue
        xyz = np.array([float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54])])
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and rn in AA3: prot.append((rs, rn, at, xyz))
        elif ln.startswith("HETATM") and rn in ("AMP", "GLN"): lig.append((rs, rn, at, xyz))
    return prot, lig

def af(acc):
    meta = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}", timeout=180).json()[0]
    return requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"], timeout=180).text

S = {"ASNSD1 (AF-Q9NWL6)":  (parse_pdb(af("Q9NWL6"))[0], 494),
     "human ASNS (AF-P08243)": (parse_pdb(af("P08243"))[0], 365)}
ct9 = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1CT9.pdb", timeout=180).text
p9, l9 = parse_pdb(ct9, chain="A")
S["E. coli AS-B (1CT9 A)"] = (p9, 348)

CARBOX = {("ASP","OD1"),("ASP","OD2"),("GLU","OE1"),("GLU","OE2")}
print("=== acidic side-chain oxygens near the target residue's CB ===")
rows = []
for name, (prot, tgt) in S.items():
    cb = [x for rs, rn, at, x in prot if rs == tgt and at in ("CB", "CA")]
    ident = {rn for rs, rn, at, x in prot if rs == tgt}
    ref = cb[0]
    near = {}
    for rs, rn, at, x in prot:
        if rs == tgt: continue
        if (rn, at) in CARBOX:
            d = float(np.linalg.norm(x - ref))
            if d < 10.0: near[(rs, rn)] = min(near.get((rs, rn), 99), d)
    n6 = sum(1 for d in near.values() if d < 6)
    n8 = sum(1 for d in near.values() if d < 8)
    closest = sorted(near.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[:4]
    print(f"\n{name}: residue {tgt} = {ident}")
    print(f"   acidic residues with a carboxylate O within 6 A of CB: {n6};  within 8 A: {n8};  within 10 A: {len(near)}")
    print("   closest: " + ", ".join(f"{AA3[rn]}{rs} {d:.1f}A" for (rs, rn), d in closest))
    rows.append(dict(structure=name, target=tgt, residue=AA3[list(ident)[0]], n_acidic_6A=n6, n_acidic_8A=n8,
                     n_acidic_10A=len(near),
                     closest=";".join(f"{AA3[rn]}{rs}:{d:.2f}" for (rs, rn), d in closest)))

# geometric reference: Glu348 carboxylate to AMP alpha-phosphate in 1CT9
pa = [x for rs, rn, at, x in l9 if rn == "AMP" and at in ("P", "PA")]
e348 = [x for rs, rn, at, x in p9 if rs == 348 and at in ("OE1", "OE2")]
if pa and e348:
    d = min(np.linalg.norm(a - b) for a in e348 for b in pa)
    print(f"\n1CT9: Glu348 carboxylate O to AMP phosphorus = {d:.2f} A "
          f"(the catalytic carboxylate sits directly on the nucleotide phosphate)")
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv("acidic_census.csv", index=False)

# ---- Fisher test on the deep-taxon scan (counts from the previous cell) ----
asnsd1_acidic, asnsd1_n = 0, 1731
asns_acidic,  asns_n   = 1817, 1869
odds, p = fisher_exact([[asnsd1_acidic, asnsd1_n - asnsd1_acidic],
                        [asns_acidic,  asns_n - asns_acidic]])
print(f"\nFisher exact, acidic vs non-acidic at this position, ASNSD1 family vs ASNS family: p = {p:.3g}")

# ---- figure ----
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.6))
d1 = {'L':686,'I':392,'S':380,'M':154,'A':37,'T':34,'H':19,'V':17}
d2 = {'E':1763,'D':54,'Q':30,'M':10,'L':4,'I':2,'T':2,'H':1}
res_order = ['E','D','Q','L','I','S','M','A','T','H','V']
w = 0.4; xs = np.arange(len(res_order))
ax[0].bar(xs - w/2, [100*d1.get(r,0)/1731 for r in res_order], w, color="#c0392b", label="ASNSD1 family (n=1731)")
ax[0].bar(xs + w/2, [100*d2.get(r,0)/1869 for r in res_order], w, color="#2471a3", label="ASNS/AsnB family (n=1869)")
ax[0].set_xticks(xs); ax[0].set_xticklabels(res_order)
ax[0].set_ylabel("percent of family members")
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue at the AS-B Glu348 equivalent position")
ax[0].set_title("The catalytic carboxylate is absent from the entire ASNSD1 family")
ax[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)

grp = ["Vertebrata","Arthropoda","Nematoda","Mollusca","Viridiplantae","Fungi","Bacteria"]
a_pct = {"Vertebrata":0.0,"Arthropoda":0.0,"Nematoda":0.0,"Mollusca":0.0,"Viridiplantae":0.0,"Fungi":0.0,"Bacteria":np.nan}
b_pct = {"Vertebrata":99.7,"Arthropoda":99.6,"Nematoda":100.0,"Mollusca":88.2,"Viridiplantae":100.0,"Fungi":98.4,"Bacteria":86.6}
xs = np.arange(len(grp))
ax[1].bar(xs - w/2, [a_pct[g] for g in grp], w, color="#c0392b", label="ASNSD1 family")
ax[1].bar(xs + w/2, [b_pct[g] for g in grp], w, color="#2471a3", label="ASNS/AsnB family")
ax[1].set_xticks(xs); ax[1].set_xticklabels(grp, rotation=30, ha="right")
ax[1].set_ylabel("percent acidic at the position"); ax[1].set_ylim(0, 105)
ax[1].set_title("Loss predates the vertebrates and holds in every eukaryotic group")
ax[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
for a_ in ax: a_.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
